requirements.normative_requirement: Security-significant human policy is parsed into a closed normalized IR before authorization or backend rendering.
requirements.primary_verification: Type/dependency tests proving backend API accepts only normalized/effective IR.

requirements.normative_requirement: Requested operations are a closed tagged union; effect and durability classes are derived and never caller-selected.
requirements.primary_verification: Compile-fail/property tests over every operation variant.

requirements.normative_requirement: Semantic enforcement plans are distinct from backend-rendered plans.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Semantic intent confused with backend configuration
requirements.primary_verification: Independent semantic/rendered plan digest and renderer tests.

requirements.normative_requirement: Protocol DTOs are converted immediately into domain types and are not semantic or digest authority.
requirements.primary_verification: Vary Protobuf ordering/unknown fields while preserving semantic digest.

requirements.normative_requirement: Security-significant IR contains no arbitrary expressions or untyped extension maps.
requirements.primary_verification: Schema/type scan rejects generic expression or untyped extension maps.

requirements.normative_requirement: Canonical artifacts use the deterministic-CBOR v1 profile and domain-separated SHA-256.
